name: Med Associates
old_description: Founded in 1971, Med Associates, Inc has become the leading manufacturer, software developer, and supplier of products for behavioral psychology, pharmacology, neuroscience, and related fields of research.
about:
Med Associates was established in 1971 in Fairfax, Vermont, as a small research and development company. The business remains privately held and has grown to operate facilities in both Vermont and Florida, with a network of dealers and authorized distributors worldwide.

Today the company employs over 100 people and manufactures and distributes more than 400 product lines. Its production floor includes automated computer-controlled mills, saws, lathes, routers, and a pick-and-place circuit board assembly line, enabling custom fabrication of behavioral research instrumentation, software, and integrated hardware systems.

Med Associates serves researchers in behavioral psychology, pharmacology, neuroscience, and related biomedical fields. Its equipment supports applications such as operant conditioning, self-administration, fear conditioning, maze testing, and ultrasonic vocalization detection, and is used in universities, pharmaceutical labs, and government research institutions.

The company states that its differentiation rests on three principles: commitment to basic research, state-of-the-art R&D, and manufacturing excellence. It emphasizes close collaboration with researchers to design and refine tools, and it runs a Short Courses in Neuroscience series alongside on-site installation and training programs.
